verdict.rationale: Workers documents built-in observability linked to a logs page, which covers runtime logs. Workers Builds and Observability are exposed as separate managed MCP servers, but nothing shows build, deploy, and runtime logs brought together in a single view. missing for 10: evidence of build-log viewing, deploy-log viewing, a unified single-pane view across build/deploy/runtime, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view all my build, deploy, and runtime logs in one place

citations.quote: Gain deep visibility and insight with built-in [observability](/workers/observability/logs/)
